(i) $M(\lambda)$ is a $U({\mathfrak g}_-^{(S)})$-free module of rank 1 generated by the $S$-highest weight vector $1\otimes 1$ of weight $\lambda$.
ewline (ii) $\dim M(\lambda)_{\lambda} =1$; $0<\dim M(\lambda)_{\lambda - k \delta} < \infty$ for any integer $k>0$; if $\mu 
eq \lambda- k\delta$ for any integer $k \ge 0$ and $M(\lambda)_{\mu} 
eq 0$, then $\dim M(\lambda)_{\mu} = \infty$.
ewline (iii) Let $V$ be a $U(A_1^{(1)})$-module generated by some $S$-highest weight vector $v$ of weight $\lambda$. Then there exists a unique surjective homomorphism $\varphi:M(\lambda) 	o V$ such that $\varphi(1 \otimes 1) =v$. 
ewline (iv) $M(\lambda)$ has a unique maximal submodule. 
ewline (v) Let $\lambda, \mu \in P$. Any non-zero element of $	ext{Hom}\,_{U(A_1^{(1)})}(M(\lambda),M(\mu))$ is injective.
ewline (vi) $M(\lambda)$ is irreducible if and only if $\lambda(c)
eq 0$. \hskip 1cm $\square$
card.label: Proposition 1

paper.title: Imaginary Verma modules and Kashiwara algebras for $U_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$
paper.abstract: We consider imaginary Verma modules for quantum affine algebra $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ and construct Kashiwara type operators and the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$. We show that a certain quotient $\mathcal N_q^-$ of $U_q(\hat{\mathfrak{sl}(2)})$ is a simple $\mathcal K_q$-module.
